[GENERATED IMPLEMENTATION]
import data.list.basic
import data.nat.basic
import tactic.lint

def implementation (n: Nat) : List Nat :=
  let rec aux (acc: List Nat) (n: Nat) : List Nat :=
    if n = 1 then
      1 :: acc
    else
      let next := if n % 2 = 0 then n / 2 else n * 3 + 1
      if collatz_reachable n next then
        next :: aux (next :: acc) next
      else
        aux acc next
  aux [] n
[END]
[HELPER LEMMAS]
lemma collatz_reachable_transitive (n m p : Nat) :
  collatz_reachable n m → collatz_reachable m p → collatz_reachable n p :=
begin
  intros h1 h2,
  obtain ⟨k1, hk1⟩ := h1,
  obtain ⟨k2, hk2⟩ := h2,
  use k1 + k2,
  simp [Nat.iterate] at hk2,
  simp [hk1, hk2]
end

lemma collatz_reachable_1 (n: Nat) :
  collatz_reachable n 1 :=
begin
  use 0,
  simp [Nat.iterate]
end

lemma collatz_reachable_odd (n m: Nat) (h: Odd m) (hn: collatz_reachable n m) :
  collatz_reachable n (m / 2) :=
begin
  cases h with h,
  have h' := congr_arg (λ x, x / 2) h,
  rw [h'],
  use 1 + Nat.find h',
  rw [Nat.find_spec] at h',
  simp [Nat.iterate, h, h']
end

lemma collatz_reachable_even (n m: Nat) (h: Even m) (hn: collatz_reachable n m) :
  collatz_reachable n (m * 3 + 1) :=
begin
  cases h with h,
  have h' := congr_arg (λ x, x * 3 + 1) h,
  rw [h'],
  use 1 + Nat.find h',
  rw [Nat.find_spec] at h',
  simp [Nat.iterate, h, h']
end

lemma collatz_reachable_reachable (n m: Nat) (h: collatz_reachable n m) :
  collatz_reachable m n :=
begin
  cases h with k hk,
  use k,
  simp [Nat.iterate]
end

lemma collatz_reachable_sort (n: Nat) :
  result.Sorted (· < ·) :=
begin
  simp [implementation],
  intros a b h,
  simp [Nat.iterate] at h,
  cases h with k hk,
  simp [Nat.iterate] at hk,
  have h' := collatz_reachable_sort (Nat.iterate (fun x => if x % 2 = 0 then x / 2 else x * 3 + 1) k n),
  simp [h', hk]
end
[END]
[PROOF]
by
unfold problem_spec
let result := implementation n
use result
simp [result]
simp [implementation]
by_cases h_n_pos: n > 0
-- case where n > 0
have h_n_pos': 0 < n := by
  linarith
simp [h_n_pos']
have h_result_sorted: result.Sorted (· < ·) :=
  collatz_reachable_sort n
have h_result_reachable: ∀ m, m ∈ result ↔ Odd m ∧ collatz_reachable n m := by
  intros m hm,
  induction m generalizing hm,
  simp [hm],
